task: Add a host-neutral retired-root guard so legacy Orchestrate cannot keep accepting new mutating Lattice writes after proofbound becomes canonical.
outcome: When a user or agent runs a mutating command in /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate, the terminal says that the root is retired and points to /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound; read-only inspection commands still work for evidence lookup.
facts: /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound is the canonical active checkout for future Lattice work.
/Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate is now a legacy evidence root that should remain readable but should not accept new story/checklist/review/test writes.
B-3523 and B-fbb6 old worktrees have been preserved under proofbound/.worktrees and old Orchestrate active worktrees have been discarded.
CLI command ownership is already centralized in packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts and resolved dynamically in packages/main/src/cli/ownership-gate.ts.
The correct guard must be Host-neutral and Agent-neutral: it must not depend on Codex, Claude, or any single host namespace.
constraints: Do not optimize for the sake of optimization; add only the correctness guard needed to prevent old-root writes.
Do not optimize arbitrarily; reuse existing command ownership classification instead of creating a second command taxonomy.
Only fix real correctness issues: retired roots must block mutating commands while preserving read-only evidence access.
Maintain consistency of logic with existing phase/owner-lease gates and command-policy semantics.
Do not delete legacy Orchestrate evidence and do not finish or merge B-3523/B-fbb6 business changes in this story.
